report_identity.report_title: China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs and sells integrated circuit chips, mainly in Mainland China.

segments.name: Integrated circuit products and services
segments.business_substance: Sale of integrated circuit products and provision of services; managed as a single segment.

business_overview.revenue_model: Product sales and services recognised when product control transfers to customers; most revenue is goods sales.
business_notes: Nearly 100% of revenue is attributable to Mainland China and over 90% of non-current assets are located in Mainland China.
Three external customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue in 2025.

non_recurring_items.item: Government grants from ordinary course of business
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government grants included in other income; recurring character not fully assured for owner earnings.

non_recurring_items.item: Interest income in other income and finance income
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest income on cash/deposits and guarantee deposits; not treated as operating chip business cash profit after detachable cash analysis.
Inventory provision reversal included in cost of sales after sale of previously impaired slow-moving inventories.

non_recurring_items.item: Change in fair value of investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value loss on investment properties included in other income.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash, bank/on-hand balance and short-term time deposits.
Time deposits with original maturity over three months plus HK$2,000 restricted cash.

operating_assets.business_substance: Work in progress and finished goods for IC chip business.
Trade receivables, supplier guarantee deposits, VAT input, prepayments and deposits.

investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, Statement of Financial Position and Note 17, pp.64, 129-130

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Shareholder loans and entrusted related-party loans due within one year.

operating_liabilities.item: Trade and other payables and contract liabilities
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables, accrued expenses, customer deposits and customer prepayments.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year cash conversion is acceptable in aggregate, but 2025 profit quality is reduced by government grants, interest income, inventory provision reversal and sharp profit decline.

gaps: No split of bank time deposits by remaining maturity between 3-12 months and over 1 year.
No complete split of detachable cash at listed parent versus Mainland operating subsidiaries.
No separate disclosure of maintenance capex versus growth capex.
